[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/16785726-f537-4309-8894-14f1e17f8276?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**[[Watch my remarks from the rally here.]](https://substack.com/redirect/98d9f8a2-e4ee-4d28-9aa7-e4f8bb99530b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
And if you'd rather read them, here's a transcript of what I said:
* * *
Good evening, Rochester.
Let me ask you this: Are you fired up for Stefany? Are you fired up for Cinde? How about this -- are you fired up for Pete?
I am too. It's pretty special to have him back in New Hampshire. We'll get to him in a second.
I'm fired up. And by the way, there is no better place to be on a Friday night in October, in the throes of the most important midterm election in our lifetime, than right here in the city of Rochester.
So thanks for coming out, everyone. Thanks to Mayor Grassie for the invitation and for your leadership.
We know New Hampshire.
Many of you have been doing the hard work over the last year and a half.
_You 've been showing up time and again._
_You 've been out there protesting._
_You 've been writing to our offices._
_You 've been speaking out._
_You 've been doing your job as citizens each and every day._
And we know New Hampshire folks are fiercely independent.
They don't want someone telling them what to do or what to think, and we want the people who represent us in Washington and in Concord to be accountable to the people of New Hampshire.
But right now, if you haven't noticed, we got a whole lot of money being spent on television right now by Donald Trump and corporate special interests who want to avoid accountability.
They know that if they win here in New Hampshire, they're going to maintain Republican control of the United States Senate, and they are all in.
They're all in for the candidate who they know will enable them to continue doing what they've been doing for the last year and a half, which hasn't worked for Granite Staters, has it?
So you may remember this guy, John Sununu.
His name is in the Epstein files.
He had a failed political career at one point in New Hampshire.
This guy thinks he can coast back to the United States Senate on more than $50 million of special interest money and some confusion with his more popular younger brother, who shares the last name.
But the fact is while it must be nice to go through life with the confidence of a mediocre Sununu, this election is about more.
It's about more than John or Chris Sununu.
**The truth is John Sununu already had his turn. He had his chance.**
He went down to Washington three decades ago when he was our Congressman and our Senator, and he blew it.
He voted down the line for an unpopular Republican President -- that was George W. Bush at the time.
He supported forever wars, including championing the invasion of Iraq.
He handed Wall Street a $700 billion bailout while screwing Main Street.
He spearheaded efforts to privatize Social Security -- do you remember that one?
And he voted to cut Medicare and Medicaid.
He helped give us the anti-choice majority on the Supreme Court we have today that delivered the end of _Roe v. Wade_ and the _Dobbs_ decision.
After voters came to their senses and turned him out of office in 2008, he did what he did best at the time.
He sold out.
He sold out the people of New Hampshire.
He went and took that seat that big corporations were saving for him in the boardroom, and he shilled for Big Pharma, for Big Oil, for the insurance companies, earning up to $35 million, trading on the relationships that he made representing New Hampshire.
Now he's on the ballot again, trying to ride that revolving door back into power in the United States Senate, supporting the same failed policies, and pretty much trying to hide every day from the tough questions.
_I mean, have you even seen this guy out there around New Hampshire at all?_
He's not showing up for New Hampshire.
If you think this is the time, if you think this is the moment to bring back a failed candidate with failed ideas from the past, then John Sununu might be your candidate.
And if you want to maintain the rigged system that we have in favor of corporate special interests who have hijacked our economy and our political system, then John Sununu is probably for you.
And if you're interested in giving a vote of confidence to Donald Trump and his administration, then John Sununu is probably your candidate.
**But I 'm running to be a very different kind of Senator for the people of New Hampshire.**
I'm running to challenge the status quo, to take on corruption and corporate power, and stand up to this incompetent President every chance we get.
I'm running because the people of New Hampshire deserve a Senator who's grounded in the people, places, and values, and who is focused on making lives better for everyday Granite Staters.
Now we know it isn't easy out there.
We hear it all the time.
We see it in our own lives.
Everything is getting so expensive, and the chaos, corruption, and costs that are coming out of Washington D.C. are sending New Hampshire families into a tailspin, economically speaking.
Donald Trump refers to this as an American golden age, but no one's buying that bullshit.
Not the truck driver paying record costs for diesel when he fills up his rig -- he's not buying it.
Not the family who just dropped their health insurance -- they're not buying it.
Not the seniors who just had their food assistance cut or the small businesses that are getting hammered by tariffs. Not the recent college graduate that's still struggling to find an affordable apartment in New Hampshire, and not the new American that's carrying documentation every day because they fear being targeted by Donald Trump's disgraceful ICE enforcement.
These folks know they're not living in a golden age, and they're just trying to make it every day.
These Granite Staters don't have an army of lobbyists working for them.
They don't have a gold pass to Mar-a-Lago to get special treatment, and they certainly don't have a super PAC that's airing TV ads on their behalf. But they damn well deserve a United States Senator who's going to fight for them each and every day, and that's the Senator I want to be for the Granite State.
I'm fighting for hardworking families so that we can build an economy with a strong middle class, with sturdy rungs on the ladder of opportunity.
I'm fighting for the chance for everyone to get a great public education and the knowledge, skills, and training they need to build a life.
I'm fighting to build more housing and ensure that private equity and Wall Street can't price us out of New Hampshire.
I'm fighting for affordable health care for each and every American and Granite Stater, and I'll take on Big Pharma and the insurance companies who are reaping record profits at our expense.
I'm fighting for childcare as a national priority to support our families and strengthen our workforce.
I'm fighting to save Social Security so that it's there for today's retirees and tomorrow's.
And I'm fighting for clean air and clean water and to make sure we're acting on climate change to save this planet.
I'm fighting to end this war and make sure we're always making good on our commitment to our service members and our veterans.
And I'm fighting to fix a broken political system, because if we're going to make progress, we've got to make sure that we are taking on the corruption in Washington D.C.
We've got to make sure that we are getting big money out of our political system, that we're ending partisan gerrymandering, and that we're overturning the _Citizens United_ decision.
We've got to clean up Washington by banning stock trading, shutting down the revolving door between Congress and K Street, and imposing tough ethical guidelines and term limits for Congress and the Supreme Court.
We've got to get down to business and fight for the kind of future that Granite Staters and Americans deserve.
We've got to challenge this disgraceful, broken presidency and chart a better course for our economy and our democracy.
And we can begin to do that when we win up and down the ticket and when we deliver the kind of change that New Hampshire deserves.
Folks, you know this because you've been showing up for the past year and a half.
This is not a time to stand down.
It's a time to stand up.
And it's not a time to flinch in the face of adversity.
It's a time to fight back with everything we've got.
We've got 32 days.
We've got 32 days to make a difference.
32 days to knock on every door.
32 days to make those phone calls.
32 days to put out the signs.
32 days to talk to our friends and neighbors about the stakes of this election.
So my question to you is this: _Are you ready to win, New Hampshire?_
Here in the Live Free or Die state, we know that our elected officials and elected positions are not for sale.
This Senate seat doesn't belong to Donald Trump or the corporate special interests or politicians from either party. It belongs to you, the people of New Hampshire.
So together, let's do it.
Let's do the hard work.
Let's deliver a fairer economy.
Let's deliver a government that's accountable, and let's deliver a future where everyone has a stake.
Let's get out there and win, folks.
Thanks very much for being here.
Thank you all so much.

body:
Here's the latest breaking news at The Maine Wire

** Maine to Automatically Enroll Eligible Households in Electric Bill Discount Program (https://us.list-manage.com/ZHo29f3YM_2?e=f093fa355c&c2id=ed20d54774fd5b0d29c30444211870ed)
------------------------------------------------------------
By Libby Palanza on Oct 04, 2026 11:59 am
Gov. Janet Mills (D) announced Thursday that low-income Maine households will be automatically enrolled in a program that discounts their electric bills. subject: Why JD Vance’s story meant so much to Charlie Kirk
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Patriot,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack.

Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God.

For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed.

And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives.

Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for.

He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Patriot, Faith is essential to the survival and success of America. Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth. He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him. He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country. That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt. That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith. Patriot, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story... It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now. So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together. Young people face that pressure every single day. They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is. JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion. He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back. That's what Communion is about... And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now. That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith. Your support does far more than just send you a book... It helps Turning Point USA reach young people in the very places where faith is under attack. Because of supporters like you, students on more than 5,000 campuses are hearing something they may not hear anywhere else: a serious defense of faith, truth, and a life rooted in God. For many of them, that's the first time anyone has challenged the lies they have been fed. And for many of them, that's where their minds begin to change -- and so do their lives. Charlie believed the next generation was worth fighting for. He believed young people were not beyond reach -- they needed someone willing to meet them where this battle is being fought and tell them the truth clearly and directly. That's why your support matters. It helps Turning Point USA keep showing up. And it helps carry forward the mission Charlie gave his life to build. | | | Now's the time to act. Good morning Willis, it's Pete Buttigieg.
Over the last year and a half, I've traveled to more than 30 states. I've been to big cities, small towns, a lot of so-called red districts, and swing seats that are going to shape who controls Congress next.
Everywhere I go, I'm meeting people who are hungry for something different and better.
And when I say better, I don't just mean better than now. I mean better than before.
I am also talking about the kind of leaders who will not just deliver policies, but a better kind of politics as well – where you could look at the news, look at your feed, see what your elected officials are doing, and actually feel your blood pressure come down a little bit instead of going up through the roof.
Congressman Chris Deluzio is one of those people.
When I was Transportation Secretary, Chris was one of the key leaders pushing the Railway Safety Act in response to the 2023 Norfolk Southern derailment in East Palestine – the one that sent toxic smoke into the sky just across the state line from his constituents in Beaver County. While the railroad lobby worked to stall the bill, Chris never let up.
I've worked with him to put an end to surprise "junk fees" – the surprise charges you get when buying airplane tickets, renting cars, and more.
He's a fellow veteran. He's tough. He gives people something to vote for, not just against.
And today, I am asking you to make a contribution to his re-election campaign.
Think of it as an act of hope. Of all the things you could be doing with $3, you are making a contribution toward a kind of politics that can actually make everyday life better. That we don't have to live like this. That we can have a country where if something is broken, we have leaders who actually do that it takes to fix it.
**[So please, Willis. If you can, use this link to make a contribution of $3 or whatever it is you can afford directly to Chris Deluzio's campaign for Congress in Pennsylvania.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261005&t=3&akid=113%2E42639%2EG-8REP)**

Derek, we’ll be upfront about it: This is a fundraising email. When we’re done, we’re going to ask you to [_**chip in as much as you can to make sure Team Shapiro has the resources to expand our latest ad buy, reach thousands of undecided voters before our opponent, and protect Pennsylvania’s elections from Donald Trump’s handpicked Republican nominee.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140657986/651229649/-1660135240?refcode=email_100526_myth&refode=email_100526_myth&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YzNhOGVlOS1iMmMwLWYxMTEtYTZhOS0wMDBkM2E1NmQyZjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SXf9TmCp37AwmQHhTNHW8NVip0DzL3fiwwmWR5IVSoA=) But before we do that, we want to set the record straight about this campaign — so if there’s a reason why you might be hesitant to pitch in today, we want to dispel a few myths you may have heard about our election. **Myth #1: “The polls show Josh Shapiro ahead, so he’s clearly going to win.”** Derek, if there’s anything we’ve learned from the past few elections, it’s that you can never trust what the polls say — especially in Pennsylvania. There are still 29 days to go in this race, and we never know what could happen or how it could swing our momentum. **Myth #2: “My donation will have more of an impact if I chip in closer to Election Day.”** This could not be more false. Pennsylvanians are filling out their mail-in ballots _right this second_ — so every extra day a potential supporter waits to chip in, that’s thousands of fewer voters we’re able to reach _before_ they fill out their ballots. **Myth #3: “Josh Shapiro doesn’t need my donation.”** In 2024, $1.2 billion was spent in Pennsylvania on campaign ads _alone_ — more than any other state. That number doesn’t even account for the Get Out The Vote efforts, rallies, or yard sign production! Case File No DRT-ED-IRAN · Special File · The Second Story
The Explosions Get the Coverage. The Oil Tankers Tell the Real Story.
The official reason for the Iran war is nuclear. But the blockade has also cut off China’s cheapest oil, Beijing just halted fuel exports, and Washington now owns a stake in Venezuelan crude. Here’s the story behind the strikes.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
The official reason for the war with Iran fits in one sentence: Iran must never get a nuclear weapon. Trump has repeated it for seven months. But wars have a habit of serving more than one purpose. If you stop watching the explosions and start watching the oil tankers, a second story appears. It runs straight to Beijing.
The evidence board
| | Follow the Barrels, Not the Bombs
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — Iran’s one big customer.** China takes more than 80% of the oil Iran ships, per Kpler data. For years, much of it went to small independent refineries in Shandong that run about a fifth of China’s refining capacity.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the squeeze.** After the U.S. naval blockade began in mid-July, China’s imports of Iranian crude fell from about 823,000 barrels a day in July to about 534,000 in August. Iranian crude that used to sell at a $3 discount began to command a premium of up to $2 a barrel.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — Beijing blinks.** On October 1, Chinese refiners suspended fuel exports beyond Hong Kong and Macau “until further notice,” per four sources briefed on the decision. Analysts read it as a sign of concern about domestic supply.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — Washington’s other barrels.** In August the U.S. government took a 35% stake in a venture producing Venezuelan oil. Trump now boasts that more oil has left the Strait of Hormuz in recent days “than at any time in history,” much of it moving under U.S. naval protection.
Decoder
| | The Reason Given, and the One That Isn’t
---|---
| | “Iran will not have a nuclear weapon.”— President Trump, on the purpose of the war
---|---
What it says
The war is about Iran’s nuclear program.
What it means
**Our theory:** that may be true and still incomplete. The blockade does something else at the same time: it cuts off the cheapest oil China’s private refiners could buy. Meanwhile, Gulf barrels move under U.S. protection and Washington owns a stake in Venezuelan crude. Whoever controls the flow of oil to the world’s biggest importer holds leverage over it, in trade talks, on Taiwan and everywhere else.
The board
| | Who Gains, Who Pays
---|---
| | LEVERAGE
---
Washington
Controls the blockade, protects the Gulf flows and holds a stake in Venezuelan oil. More say over who gets energy, and at what price.
| | SQUEEZED
---
Beijing
Lost its cheapest supplier, paid premiums for what’s left, then halted fuel exports to protect its own supply.
| | PAYING
---
Tehran
Oil revenue drying up; floating storage fell from about 105 million to 80 million barrels.
| | WATCH
---
Investors
The war’s real payoff may be in energy, shipping and defense, not in the headlines about missiles.

---|---
| ██ REDACTED ██
---

| ██ REDACTED ██
---

---

| ClassificationPressure
---
The explosions get the coverage. The money is in the oil routes being redrawn around them. Each week of blockade shifts energy leverage from Beijing toward Washington, and that shift will outlast the war.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileIf the war were only about Iran’s nuclear program, why would China be the country cutting its fuel exports?
---
|
---
Riddle answer
**Because the blockade hits Iran’s customer as much as Iran.** More than 80% of Iran’s oil went to China. When that supply dried up, Chinese refiners had to scramble, and Beijing chose to keep fuel at home. **Our theory:** that’s the clearest sign that this war is also about energy leverage, and the investors who see that early will be watching different stocks than the headlines suggest.

Hello, I hope that your fall is going great.
Muse, the new AI personal assistant from Meta, has taken the world by storm. It became #1 in App Store downloads and increased Meta's market cap by $400 billion or so.
People in my life have reacted anywhere from "No way I'd let Zuck get deep into my personal life" to "I need to try that immediately!" But it's going to become a fact of life for millions right now.
It also caused consternation in the business world. Press stories came out suggesting that if Muse were to move Americans' savings en masse from their current non-interest-bearing accounts - the average interest rate on savings that Americans actually receive is apparently only 0.1% - to high-yield savings accounts, all of the banks would go out of business. Another story said that 50% of subscriptions are being paid because we don't remember to cancel them; Muse would change that, thus gutting subscription-based companies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ebd36f7e-5af6-43a3-9f2d-67da01f66904?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I definitely have some subscriptions lingering around that I would cancel if I remembered them. AI will soon remember for us. A colleague used Muse to quit the gym for him, without having to talk to anyone or pay a visit.
AI will stamp out inefficiencies wherever it can find them. The tough part is that a LOT of people's jobs rely upon inefficiencies.
For example, hundreds of thousands of Americans work as medical billing staff; if you were to have a better, more streamlined system, you wouldn't need as many people working on verifying billing codes. Customer service employs 2.8 million people (including some people at [Noble Mobile](https://substack.com/redirect/73c86812-9c26-4ee8-ba91-9edca76ab6fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) - bots will make those workers less vital very quickly. The insurance industry, which consists largely of passing information back and forth, employs 2.9 million people, including almost 400,000 claims adjusters. AI could figure out the veracity and magnitude of claims in many routine circumstances.
I met with a banking executive this week who said, "There are two changes going on. One is that AI is getting smarter every minute and the models are getting dramatically more powerful every week or so. Two is that companies like mine are figuring out how to productize and operationalize these models in our organizations. The first process is going a lot faster than the second right now, which is one reason that corporate productivity and layoffs haven't spiked yet. But pretty soon AI will be able to help us apply it too, at which point all bets are off." This executive expects his company's staff to shrink very considerably in the coming one to two years.
Meanwhile, Anthropic's IPO is becoming real. Its S-1 leaked to reporters last week, showing 2025 revenue of $4.59 billion and commitments of $518 billion to Google, Amazon and Microsoft for compute infrastructure. It is targeting a $2 trillion IPO, which would be the biggest IPO in history, surpassing SpaceX.
Can it get there? Anthropic reported annualized revenue of $65.6 billion in July of this year, a stupendous growth rate of 14.3x from last year.
Still, from my vantage point, there is no way it can justify a valuation that high; let's say it's doing $80 billion in revenue annualized by October. $2 trillion would be 25 times revenue, while the S&P 500 trades at 3.6 times revenue and its historical multiple is 1.65x. There's growth and then there's froth, and we're clearly into the latter category.
I say this despite the fact that Claude is the preferred model for those around me in corporate contexts. I spoke to investors who warned that they saw some signs of companies pulling back from their per-employee spending on Claude due to unclear returns on investment. It's going to be tough for Anthropic to keep compounding its growth long enough to achieve a multi-trillion-dollar valuation - at some point you run out of corporate budget. And this is coming from the guy who thinks AI is going to eat a ton of jobs in these companies.
By the way, investors are also seeing lower growth rates in the demand for ChatGPT in the corporate setting. That's not what you want when the whole story is hypergrowth.
The rubber is going to hit the road when OpenAI tries to go public next year. I think that will be a dicey proposition at best, which will present a huge challenge for this AI-fueled boom. When the updraft ends, gravity remains. It may not feel like it, but we're in the air right now.
This week on the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/d439ed2c-e07b-4426-adf9-0c5c0dd4aaea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) we hear from Senate candidates [Todd Achilles](https://substack.com/redirect/eec6d694-1ad3-4508-9f94-c3a22e1591be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Seth Bodnar](https://substack.com/redirect/b8b2b90b-23c6-43ad-81f6-73cf1dcace46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/2ccf6f6f-a5af-4c15-86cf-d82103adefce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and more. To check out Forward Party candidates including Todd, Seth, and Brian, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/50d06758-6a16-40cc-b970-bac2138e5ec9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). New polls have [Todd Achilles](https://substack.com/redirect/eec6d694-1ad3-4508-9f94-c3a22e1591be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/c67b7c02-d461-4eac-9354-e9e10c3b37f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) tied with the incumbents in Idaho and South Dakota! For 3 months off your mobile bill with Noble Mobile, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/73c86812-9c26-4ee8-ba91-9edca76ab6fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or email [matt@noblemobile.com](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a31fda-94bb-49dd-a147-65b1ecff306e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and use my name to switch or explore. It will save you money and time. Make the most of what you've got while you've got it. Look up.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/002813b0-2e5b-42f3-9699-02f1831afd87?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

subject: Why I’m campaigning non-stop for the next 24 hours
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TOM PERRIELLO FOR CONGRESS
body:
The 24-hour campaign countdown clock starts now | | | |
---
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/140659853/651233416/-143260263?amount=50&refcode=261004em_tp_24hours&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmZlNjcwNzEtYjhjMC1mMTExLWE2YTktMDAwZDNhNTZkMmY3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=J_6z48fTlgXWVBQHjxNOPj-ss5SAUCafdIb9qDLUutw=)
---
| | | I have a tradition on every campaign – a ritual of sorts to show how seriously I take the act of asking for people’s vote. The idea started almost 20 years ago, based on a simple concept: **_because so many folks are working double shifts around my district just to make ends meet, I promise to work a double shift in Congress for my constituents_**. So, I am once again launching into 24 straight hours of campaigning across each of the 24 localities of Virginia’s Fifth District. We started at 7am in Amherst county, meeting with local business leaders. We will be meeting with farmers, college students, and civil rights leaders, then riding along with first responders, law enforcement, and ER workers on graveyard shifts. Nate Silver shows the same.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-hamilton.ei0hNT&refcode=em261005&t=5&akid=2515%2E135344%2ESMVqpo)

On March 30, 2010, Barack Obama signed the Health Care and Education Reconciliation Act, and buried inside the health-law cleanup was the largest nationalization of consumer debt in American history. The government abolished the bank-based FFEL program -- private lenders originating federally guaranteed loans -- and made Washington the direct originator of every federal student loan thereafter. Sixteen years later it holds roughly $1.7 trillion owed by more than 42 million people: every rate, every default, every forbearance, every forgiveness. There is no co-signer, and there is no one to sell the paper to. The case the numbers now make is not a slow leak. It's a crash.

*Ballots are being out today Colorado and California!*

Here is my ballot guide for Colorado:

*Vote YES:*
Yes on Amendment 87:
The Income Tax Fairness Act
97% of Coloradans get a tax break. Corporations and households earning
$500,000+ pay their fair share in taxes.

Yes on Proposition NN:
State investment in K-12 education to increase by 2% each year

Yes on Ballot Issue 7A:
Front Range Passenger Rail District
.333% Sales and Use Tax to fund Front Range Passenger Rail!!!!

*Vote NO:*
Vote No on Billionaire BS!!!!

There are eight Advance Colorado ballot measures, two cruel anti trans
ballot measures, and one poorly worded draconian abuse bill that could have
a lot of unintended consequences.

Vote NO on Props 81, 82, 83, 84, 85, 86, 103, 132, 134, 135, 137, & 232

Colorado if you get this text about Amendment 87, it's complete and utter
BS. Please tell your family and friends. 97% of people get a tax cut with
the graduated income tax ballot measure.

YES on 40 - Tax billionaires, federal cuts to SNAP and Medicaid have been
devastating and they have more than enough to fill the gap

NO on 41 & 42 - Both would kill the billionaire tax

The rest I'm not informed on enough.

appellants, Integrity Matters, and Citizens Against Data Centers COS
<https://www.instagram.com/citizensagainstdatacenterscos/>!
The hearing date is tentatively scheduled for mid November.

We will share more details to come, including ways to give public comment
in person and via email to Drew.Foxx@gmail.com

AI Surveillance Camera Ban & Four Year Data Center Moratorium for Colorado
Springs

If you would like to sign, I will be at OCC (Saturday 9-11am) and Acacia
Park (Sunday 9-11am) farmers markets every weekend until they close in late
October.

If you would like to circulate petitions for the AI Surveillance Camera Ban
or Four Year Data Center Moratorium for Colorado Springs use the QR codes
below:
[image: Copy of Are your anita miller 2.PNG]

Hope is a Muscle,
Zuri Horowitz
Citizens Against Data Centers - COS
<https://www.instagram.com/citizensagainstdatacenterscos/>

*Rising*Together
*Stronger*Together
When We Stand Together
Everyone Thrives
*Zuri for Congress*

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Help me fight back
body:
Vice President Vance’s attacks are working.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1583&source=&t=1&akid=4179%2E124072%2E9cltj9) | | | |
---
Peter – I’m so grateful for the surge of support from people like you that has helped us stay in the fight as the far right escalates its attacks.
**However, I’m getting worried. The final FEC fundraising deadline we have to show the power of this grassroots campaign is in just 9 days. Right now, we’re not on track to meet this crucial goal.**
We can’t afford to miss this target, Peter. The GOP is pulling out all the stops to crush our momentum. Vice President Vance even took the stage at a North Carolina rally recently to prop up my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley, **less than a week after President Trump came to town.**
After rehashing the same tired lies about me and North Carolina to fire up the base, they both headed back to Washington DC – and the GOP’s super PACs descended in his place.
Their tactics seem to be working. **Multiple polls** show this race is close. The GOP knows North Carolina is our best chance to flip a Republican-held Senate seat blue, so they won’t let up anytime soon.
Peter, it’s too late in the game to claw back the lead and win if we fall behind – and this is a race we cannot afford to lose.
[**_Will you please chip in $5 or anything you can to help us get back on track and flip this must-win seat blue? Senate control is on the line in North Carolina, and I can’t pull this off without you._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1583&amount=5&t=8&akid=4179%2E124072%2E9cltj9)

The case marks the latest in a string of alleged Chinese influence operations in California, following former Arcadia Mayor Eileen Wang's guilty plea earlier this year for running a propaganda campaign on China's behalf. Megyn Kelly blasts Gov. Hochul, Letitia James over "Cornell 7" case Megyn Kelly to oversee the "Cornell 7" gang-rape investigation, calling James biased and arguing her prior public sympathy for the accuser showed she'd already taken a side before the probe began. Kelly pointed to a Facebook post from James expressing support for the alleged victim as evidence of prejudgment, and noted James declined to address the post when questioned by a reporter at a joint press conference with Hochul. Kelly expressed strong concern for the accused fraternity members, characterizing the allegations as stemming from "a night of debauchery" \- "I am very worried for them. I am seriously concerned for these seven young men, who appear to have engaged in a night of debauchery, [and some] sent out -- in the case of one or two of them -- f--ing stupid, offensive texts messages," she explained. The case centers on an alleged gang rape at Cornell's Chi Phi fraternity house in October 2024. A woman identified only as "Jane Doe" says seven fraternity brothers assaulted her that night. She reportedly went to police after discovering messages in which the men allegedly bragged about the incident. Last month, she filed a civil lawsuit against the seven men, which brought the case into the national spotlight. Leftist musicians make fools of themselves at "Power to the People" festival A music festival featuring Bruce Springsteen, Dave Matthews, and Tom Morello combined performances with voter registration and activist organizing, promoting and pro-Palestinian chants while spotlighting Democratic-aligned nonprofits like Indivisible, the ACLU, and Third Act. The event raised proceeds for groups including Head Count and VoteRiders through tiered VIP packages, even as several performers -- including Springsteen, who previously endorsed Kamala Harris, and Matthews, a past Bernie Sanders supporter -- have long records of Democratic campaign involvement. Festival content included explicit anti-ICE rhetoric and a tribute to Aaron Bushnell, the service member who self-immolated protesting Israel's Gaza response, raising questions about whether participating 501(c)(3) nonprofits may be crossing legal boundaries against partisan campaign activity. * You're currently a free subscriber to . Seeking her mother's warmth, a toddler's lips pucker in a clumsy attempt at a first kiss. It is more than mere affection; it is the first, vital mechanic of mimicry.
This is a profound neurological dialogue. Through mirror neurons, her brain fires in concert with our every movement, internalizing the very mechanics of being. It is a bidirectional dance--the way culture and survival are transferred from one generation to the next without reinvention.
We must be intentional; we are providing the blueprints for a soul. This mimicry extends to the natural world, where the environment replicates and recycles its own essence to ensure that nothing is truly lost.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.

Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | **REGISTER and VOTE:** The last day to register to vote is TODAY!!! No matter what county you live in, you can go to [www.vote.org](https://us.list-manage.com/Bq0SvW3o3qP?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d) and check your registration! If you haven’t done it today, go ahead and check....
I’ll wait...

You back? Are you registered? If not, and you need additional help you can go to the board of elections in your county to register. Closing times may vary so check with your BOE. Most registration actions can be completed online.
[Butler County Board of Elections](https://us.list-manage.com/HYXPIkc1JHW?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d) [Greene County Board of Elections](https://us.list-manage.com/CHNBrm6TKH8?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d) [Montgomery County Board of Elections ](https://us.list-manage.com/1AhQjpACF2j?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d)
As always, your county Democratic Party is available to help. You can find more information on their websites as well and get help from their volunteers.
[BCDP ](https://us.list-manage.com/3_1T0qMLMcE?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d)[GCDP ](https://us.list-manage.com/SNIHBFIzZ4j?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d)[MCDP ](https://us.list-manage.com/AXuAnXeP6VX?e=36314ef925&c2id=95485440be040823d6a7108ee922ec5d)
---
| | | | |
**Tales From the Trail:** Team Knickerbocker has been all over the district this past week. We’re seeing you at meet and greets, events, front doors, church services, and around town.
The team attended two great NAACP candidate forums this week in Dayton and Middletown. We want to thank everyone that planned the events and all that attended. Your questions and participation help hold elected officials accountable and allows candidates an opportunity to hear the issues that are on your mind.
While Kristina shows up, you can always count on Mike to be an empty seat. Not only did we meet new people at forums, but we attended many social events throughout the district in the past week. We want to thank all of the hosts for opening up their homes and spaces to allow Team Knickerbocker to talk to our neighbors about how this campaign is about people, and not power and corruption. I’m sure you’ve heard that President Trump made an appearance in Vandalia this past weekend. Mike Turner was happy to show up and support the President, and who could blame him. Together they are responsible for another war in the middle east, high gas prices, and volatile trade policies that are running up costs and hurting small businesses in Ohio. They make a great pair!
Kristina was joined by others in the community who are ready to break up the Trump-Turner duo and elect new principled leadership in this district. Thank you to the event organizers and to all of those who came out at the last minute to stand with us against these out of touch politicians. We’re 30 days away from electing a public servant, mom, nurse, and veteran to Congress! Come get involved with campaign in this last month. There are so many ways to help, and we can’t wait to see you out there!

His campaign for Florida State House District 36 is focused on issues including affordability, healthcare, housing, utility costs, public education, teacher pay, protecting conservation lands and the rural boundary, responsible growth, and holding powerful interests accountable.

# Yemen
* **Yemen 's Saudi-backed government announces operation to retake Sana'a:** Rashad al-Alimi, head of Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council, [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/c3629911-9ef0-4f5b-b9ad-5a47357e0581?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday the launch of a military and security operation dubbed "Dawn of Yemen," aimed at retaking the capital Sana'a from Ansarallah and restoring control over state institutions.
* "The Dawn of Yemen operation has begun to restore state institutions, liberate the capital Sana'a, and end the Houthi coup," Al-Alimi said, a day after announcing the start of military operations to "restore the remaining territory of the Republic and extend state authority nationwide."
* Mohammed Al-Bukhaiti, a member of Ansarallah's political bureau, [dismissed](https://substack.com/redirect/bf381f37-e929-4c1d-9861-6b91ac0bfbe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Al-Alimi's announcement, saying "the war today is between Yemen and Saudi Arabia." He said Saudi aircraft were bombing Yemen while Ansarallah forces were responding "with missiles and drones deep inside Saudi territory," adding that "it is the Saudi regime that controls the mercenary forces, not Rashad al-Alimi."

* **Saudi-led coalition deploys 100 warplanes as Yemeni forces launch offensive:** The Saudi-led coalition said Monday that 100 fighter jets were taking part in "Operation Dawn of Yemen," providing round-the-clock air support to Saudi-backed Yemeni forces and air cover over the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait.
* Coalition spokesperson claimed 324 "high-value" targets had been destroyed since the operation began. The coalition's intervention follows overnight Saudi-backed strikes on Sana'a and the northern province of Saada.
* On the ground, Saudi-backed forces claimed Monday to have taken large parts of Dhubab district overlooking Bab al-Mandab. They also claimed control of the Dhubab airstrip and key positions around the strait, while Ansarallah-aligned media denied that Saudi-backed forces had advanced. Reuters reported that fighting remained under way in the area.
* Elsewhere, Saudi-backed forces claimed gains in southern Taiz. The military claimed it had carried out 1,122 attacks across Saada, Al-Jawf, Taiz and the western coast, killing or otherwise "neutralizing" 1,747 Ansarallah fighters. The figures could not be independently verified.
* Ansarallah said Sunday it had launched ballistic missiles and drones at Aramco facilities in Riyadh and Khurais, causing major fires. It said the strikes were retaliation for 50 Saudi airstrikes and missiles over the previous 12 hours on Sana'a, al-Jawf, Taiz, Amran, Hajjah, and Saada.
* **U.S. gives Saudi Arabia over 200 Ansarallah targets but holds off on direct strikes:** The U.S. military [provided](https://substack.com/redirect/72d6614f-1920-4175-bd95-adb1ec56f13f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Saudi Arabia with intelligence and targeting data for its operations against Ansarallah in Yemen, including more than 200 targets over the past two weeks, a U.S. official told Axios.
* Washington has twice rejected recent Saudi requests to directly join the fighting.
* Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman again asked Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday for U.S. airstrikes to support a planned Saudi-backed operation in Yemen, but a U.S. official said Washington "is not going to take kinetic action for now."
* President Donald Trump also held off on ordering strikes against Ansarallah last week after a request from Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.
* CENTCOM has raised concerns that direct U.S. involvement in Yemen would divert attention and resources from Iran, according to a U.S. official.
* U.S. officials said Washington is currently providing Saudi Arabia with support short of direct combat, but direct U.S. military action could still be considered if the Saudi-backed operation runs into difficulties.
* **Aramco CEO says rebuilding global oil stocks could take two years:** Replenishing global oil inventories while meeting demand could take "up to two years," as disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz continue amid the war with Iran, Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser said Monday.
* "The world entered the crisis with oil inventories of around 10 billion barrels" and has since "lost nearly 3 billion barrels" of oil supply, Nasser said, adding that roughly half the crude and refined products normally shipped through Hormuz have been lost. "Less than 6 billion barrels of commercial inventories remain, and most of them are practically unavailable."
* "Emergency reserves may get us through the winter, but they do not solve the supply problem in the long term," Nasser said, warning pressure would continue "until the Strait of Hormuz fully reopens and confidence returns."
* Aramco is considering additional crude export routes and overseas storage, Nasser said. "If we are asked to provide 12 million barrels per day, we can provide it within days."

# Iran
* **U.S. bombers withdrawn from RAF Fairford** : The U.S. abruptly [removed](https://substack.com/redirect/8b439bd9-e495-4c32-8953-5dbdb92819ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) all U.S. long-range bombers deployed to the RAF Fairford airbase in England and returned them to their U.S. home stations over the weekend. The move, which was not explained, comes days after British authorities arrested several individuals over what the officials have claimed was an Iranian plot targeting the base.
* Fairford has served as a forward operating location for U.S. Global Strike Command and hosted B-1 bombers used in the war against Iran.
* **Middle East crude exports surpass pre-Iran war levels:** Crude exports from the Middle East exceeded pre-war levels on four of the final seven days of September, reaching 19.5 million to 22.5 million barrels per day (bpd), according to provisional data from ship-tracking firm Kpler reported by Reuters via Al Jazeera. Before the U.S.-Israel war on Iran, exports averaged about 18 million bpd.
* The seven-day average for crude exports stood at 18.5 million bpd on October 1, while combined flows of crude, refined products, chemicals and other non-gas liquids averaged 22.4 million bpd in the seven days through September 30.
* IRGC commander Ali Fadavi disputed the scale of traffic Sunday, saying only "three to four million barrels" of oil were moving through the route each day and describing that volume as "negligible" compared with pre-war levels.
* Kpler's figures include Strait of Hormuz transits, Red Sea flows, terminal exports, and ship-to-ship transfers in the Gulf of Oman, but exclude vessels traveling with their tracking transponders switched off.

* **IRGC orders tanker to turn back in Strait of Hormuz after string of attacks:** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ordered an inbound tanker in the Strait of Hormuz to turn back on Monday, warning that the vessel would otherwise be targeted, according to the UK Maritime Trade Operations. The tanker complied with the order, which was issued about 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman.
* The incident follows three consecutive days of attacks on tankers in and around the Strait. On Sunday, a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile that damaged its engine room. On Saturday, a crude oil tanker was hit on its port side by an unknown projectile four nautical miles east of Oman. On Friday, another tanker was struck during an outbound transit, causing a small fire and blackout before the vessel resumed its journey.
* No casualties or environmental impacts were reported in any of the three attacks.

* **Iran summons Norwegian ambassador over Starlink operations:** Iran [summoned](https://substack.com/redirect/d78585ea-c093-4568-989b-7ffe955708b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Norway's ambassador in Tehran on Sunday and lodged a formal protest over Oslo's failure to stop unauthorized Starlink operations inside Iran.
* Iran's Foreign Ministry accused the U.S. and Israel of using Starlink to advance an "interventionist and divisive agenda" in Iran and criticized Norway for taking no effective action despite repeated requests from Tehran.
* **Iraq to resume direct flights to Iran on Thursday:** Iraqi Airways will [resume](https://substack.com/redirect/141f69af-8744-40e8-8af6-afb30a98164b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) direct flights to Iran on October 8, Iraq's Transport Ministry announced Monday.
* The new schedule will include daily flights between Najaf International Airport and Tehran, Mashhad and Isfahan.
* Iraq halted flights to and from Iran on September 25 in line with U.S. sanctions and subsequently sought exemptions for pilgrimage, medical and educational travel. Reuters reported that the U.S. Treasury exemption for Iraqi Airways runs for one month, with a more permanent arrangement potentially to follow.

* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 is now 74,243 killed, with 175,232 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,460 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,116, while 836 bodies have been recovered.

* In northern Gaza, a woman was shot in the head by Israeli naval forces in the Al-Sudaniya area northwest of Gaza City. Another woman was wounded by Israeli quadcopter fire in the Zeitoun neighborhood, southeast of Gaza City.

In Burqa, northwest of Nablus, settlers attacked farmers harvesting olives in the Bab Al-Jamea area, prevented them from continuing their work and stole a tractor.

* **Palestinian olive sector loses over $157 million since 2023:** Palestinian farmers [lost](https://substack.com/redirect/fb6fcd0b-cda6-46dd-90c1-f5d138370a36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) more than $157 million in olive crops since 2023, while some 286,000 olive trees in the occupied West Bank were damaged between 2023 and the end of September 2026 due to Israeli measures and settler attacks, according to the Palestinian Agriculture Ministry.

Farmers are currently unable to access roughly 30% of the West Bank's olive-growing land, due to Israeli restrictions, settler attacks, land seizures, and the theft of olive crops.
* In Gaza, more than 90% of an estimated two million olive trees have been lost since the war began in 2023, alongside extensive destruction of infrastructure supporting the olive sector.
* **Israeli attacks damage or destroy 82% of Gaza 's buildings:** Around 201,290 buildings in Gaza, or an estimated 82% of all buildings in the Strip, were damaged by Israeli attacks between October 7, 2023 and June 16, 2026, according to the Palestinian Central Bureau of Statistics.

* **Somalia 's president says country won't accept Israeli presence "under any circumstances": **Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud [told](https://substack.com/redirect/7c15fb87-a32f-4636-9eac-d6f5094b829e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Al Jazeera on Sunday that Somalia will not accept an Israeli presence "under any circumstances."

# U.S. News
* **Trump announces $90 payments to 20 million seniors from Medicare Improvement Fund, surprising Congress:** President Donald Trump announced on Saturday [plans](https://substack.com/redirect/abdf1bd7-81af-4287-8b3d-fc6522fd0702?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to send $90 payments to more than 20 million Medicare Part B enrollees this month, funded by about $2 billion from the Medicare Improvement Fund, which has gone unused for its stated purpose--namely, improving Medicare's hospital and medical insurance programs--since its 2008 creation.
* The announcement caught congressional offices in both parties by surprise and could unravel unrelated funding talks, a GOP aide told the Washington Post. Lawmakers originally intended to use Improvement Fund monies to help fund several other programs, including the Community Health Center Fund, the National Health Service Corps, the Teaching Health Center Graduate Medical Education program and several special diabetes programs, according to the aide.
* **Hegseth signals some U.S. troops could shift from Europe to Western Hemisphere** : Defense Secretary **Pete Hegseth** [told](https://substack.com/redirect/8818c613-867d-409f-ad60-3d0544f9838b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reporters on Saturday that some U.S. military capabilities currently in Europe could be redeployed "either back home to the big, beautiful base that we're going to build ... or to a different posture in the Western Hemisphere," part of the administration's push for "burden sharing" with the U.S.'s European allies and its increasing focus on military activity in the Western Hemisphere.
* Hegseth cited expanded partnerships with Ecuador, Honduras, Guatemala, and Panama in his remarks on Saturday, crediting "the bold move the president made in Venezuela" in capturing **Nicol as Maduro** with opening "a whole new suite of options economically and militarily." He also reiterated the U.S. is at "war" with cartels, vowing to "posture and base as necessary" to take the fight to what he called "those ISIS and Al Qaeda of our hemisphere."
* **Montana court blocks birthdate requirement on absentee ballots that led to thousands of rejections** : A Montana state court [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/9e8098e2-cae5-4a18-b42a-712bbfd8ef73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Friday night that HB 719, a 2025 law requiring absentee voters to include their birthdate on ballot envelopes or have their votes rejected, violates the state constitution, a win for disability advocates who argued the requirement increased the risk of valid ballots being thrown out over technicalities.
* The law led to nearly 3,000 rejected mail ballots in the November 2025 election in a state where roughly 80 percent of voters cast absentee ballots. State officials failed to produce evidence of voter fraud justifying the law or explain how the birthdate requirement would prevent it, the court noted in its decision, stressing as well "the undisputed fact HB 719 has resulted in thousands of ballots being rejected due to a missing or incorrect birth year."
* **Judge blocks DHS environmental waivers, slowing border wall construction in Big Bend region** : U.S. District Judge **Kathleen Cardone** [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/5794f6f0-bb76-402a-9178-00470030b3d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a preliminary injunction Friday blocking the Department of Homeland Security from using waivers that exempted border barrier construction from historical and environmental protection laws across more than 500 miles of Texas's Big Bend region, which includes Big Bend Ranch State Park and Big Bend National Park.
* The order requires DHS to follow those laws while the legal challenge brought by Friends of the Ruidosa Church, river guide **Danny William Miller** and the Center for Biological Diversity proceeds.
* The ruling follows a separate judge's Thursday denial of a temporary restraining order specific to the national park, where the administration paused work through Sept. 30. DHS has said it is considering reducing the project's scope, for which a $1.7 billion contract was already doled out to construct a "Big Bend border wall." In filings, the administration said it would announce a final decision this week.
* **DHS bought five planes from Noem donor 's firm at inflated prices in her final hours as secretary: **On **Kristi Noem 's **last day as homeland security secretary, DHS [agreed](https://substack.com/redirect/6e1ee1da-72ce-42e4-8f3e-33f78cd89f97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to pay Daedalus Aviation Corporation $108 million for a luxury 737 that the firm had bought months earlier from a seller asking under $90 million, plus $106 million for two Gulfstream jets Daedalus had purchased for about $83 million and $45 million each for two 17-year-old 737 passenger jets that six aviation experts told the Times were worth roughly $15-30 million, according to a Sunday report from the New York Times.
* Daedalus's chairman, **William Walters** , gave $10,000 to Noem's political action committee in 2024, and his companies received more than $900 million in DHS contracts under Noem. Her successor at DHS, current secretary **Markwayne Mullin** , explored canceling the deal but, per two White House officials, was advised by Chief of Staff **Susie Wiles** against it over potential financial penalties.
* **U.S.-Russia Ukraine talks now include multibillion-dollar Lukoil oil deal tied to Trump allies** : U.S.-Russia negotiations over ending the Ukraine war have [expanded](https://substack.com/redirect/0040b56a-77a1-45bb-8c59-16599c1420ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to include a multibillion-dollar sale of Lukoil's international oil assets, the New York Times reported on Saturday, with the leading bidder group featuring **Todd Boehly** --a Trump donor who gave $2 million to Trump-aligned causes--alongside Qatar's **Khayyat brothers** , who have business ties with **Jared Kushner** and**Ivanka Trump** , an Abu Dhabi fund controlled by **Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed** that is also a business partner of Kushner and bought a large stake in Trump's World Liberty Financial, and the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation.
* Putin first raised the deal with **Steve Witkoff** and Kushner at a Sept. 5 Kremlin meeting, and U.S. approval would lift sanctions on the assets, instantly boosting their value. The deal awaits approval from the Treasury Department, with the current extension of sanctions relief on Lukoil's U.S. businesses running through Oct. 29.
* **Altman says "world should accept some bad things happening" to help AI industry: **OpenAI CEO **Sam Altman** [contrasted](https://substack.com/redirect/99a953fe-0623-4715-a8da-88ae9eab2b42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his firm's worldview with that of rival firm Anthropic in an interview with POLITICO's Decoded, saying "we believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency." * **Trump threatens to "double" costs if South Korea doesn't sign on to Alaska LNG project**: President Trump [said](https://substack.com/redirect/58bb900b-6641-4af0-b736-81ffd21a70e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) he "didn't jump the gun" in announcing South Korean participation in a $50 billion Alaska LNG project. * **Trump posts Sen. Questioning was completed on Sunday for the sixth journalist, Mohamed Ashraf Abu Emeira, and the Supreme State Security Prosecution ordered him to be held in pretrial detention for 15 days pending investigation.
* The families and lawyers of the journalists still do not know where they are being held.
* On Capitol Hill, several members of congress have called for the journalists' immediate release, including the [Egypt Human Rights Caucus](https://substack.com/redirect/dbd4b0e6-da51-4f18-8d01-9d9f88b5dfe3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), co-chaired by Reps. Don Beyer and Suzan DelBene; [Rep. Rashida Tlaib](https://substack.com/redirect/f6b33480-6c1a-46b4-b54b-31cea3db15bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Michigan, [Sen. Bernie Sanders](https://substack.com/redirect/33e4f9cf-2e07-4c25-acf0-c91f2ff025b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Vermont, [Sen. Chris Van Hollen](https://substack.com/redirect/e1a60dd5-7c5a-487d-947d-fa6a0a614641?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Maryland, and [Sen. Jeff Merkley](https://substack.com/redirect/501c0dd0-64f6-4fdf-86e1-d16aa72c4d3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Oregon.
* **Pro-Imran Khan march launches after talks with government collapse:** More than 5,000 supporters of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan [began](https://substack.com/redirect/acea4b7e-c32c-4b51-b910-972135d915db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a protest march Sunday from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province toward Islamabad after two rounds of scheduled talks between the PTI and the government over the weekend failed to reach a resolution.
* The march was originally planned for Sept. 27 and aims to secure the release of former Prime Minister Imran Khan and his three sisters. It is set to reach Khairabad, 80 km from the capital, by Thursday, where the PTI will announce its "next phase."
* Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi accused KP Chief Minister Sohail Afridi of "sabotaging" negotiations and warned authorities would "pursue [protesters] one by one" for violating an Islamabad High Court order barring parties from occupying public roads. The Pakistani government has also blocked main routes into the capital using shipping containers.
* **India, Pakistan summon each other 's diplomats over deadly border incident: **India and Pakistan [summoned](https://substack.com/redirect/0d8aeb67-dbe8-4f2f-9d8e-8b44c841a5a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) each other's top diplomats Saturday over an October 2 incident in which Pakistan says India's Border Security Force used "unprovoked lethal force" to kill two unarmed Pakistani civilians in the Bedian sector of their international border. In its account of the incident, India claimed three people crossed illegally into Punjab's Ferozepur sector and kept moving toward the border fence despite repeated warnings, forcing the BSF to "engage them for posing an imminent security threat."
* Pakistan has demanded an "immediate, transparent and credible investigation" into the incident.
* India dismissed Pakistan's account of the killings as "baseless and motivated," describing the incident as part of "a clear pattern of repeated cross-border movement by armed narcotics syndicates operating from Pakistan."
* **Mass protests demanding election chief 's resignation enter third day across India: **Thousands of youth and opposition protesters [rallied](https://substack.com/redirect/b910716e-01b2-44e0-843a-170b198c6518?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for a third straight day Sunday, demanding the resignation of Election Commission of India chief Gyanesh Kumar over voter-roll revisions critics say have removed millions of voters in ways benefiting Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party.
* Opposition leaders Raj and Uddhav Thackeray led a large protest march in Mumbai on Sunday. Similar demonstrations continued in New Delhi on Sunday evening, where police have detained dozens and filed cases against some for violating bans on mass gatherings. An opposition alliance plans to march to the election commission's office Tuesday, while the Cockroach Janta Party, a major force in these protests, plans to hold a major rally in New Delhi on October 10.
* **Air strike kills UN aid truck driver in Sudan 's South Kordofan, WFP says; RSF accused of seizing WFP aid trucks:** An air strike on clearly marked World Food Program trucks carrying food aid [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/9a448ddc-7d6e-445c-8e40-6caba3896cb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a driver Saturday in South Kordofan as the convoy traveled between two army-controlled cities, the WFP said Sunday, without identifying who was responsible. The agency called for an investigation into the killing and said it underscores "the increasingly challenging security environment in Sudan and the risks that aid workers face."
* Separately on Sunday, Abdel Baqi Mohamed Hamed, humanitarian aid commissioner for the Darfur regional government, [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/ac833ab7-c418-45da-a627-b297038b05bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces of seizing 32 World Food Programme trucks from a 60-truck convoy that crossed from Chad through the Tina border point last week. He said the RSF had released 12 of the 44 trucks it had originally seized, but continues to hold the remainder while demanding large extortion payments.
* **Dodik 's party claims victory in Bosnia election despite his ban from office: **Preliminary results from Bosnia and Herzegovina's Sunday general election [show](https://substack.com/redirect/503dd158-ffd7-4aec-bfba-0dfd68657232?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Zeljka Cvijanovic of banned Bosnian Serb leader Milorad Dodik's right-wing Alliance of Independent Social Democrats (SNSD) party leading the race for the Serb seat in the country's three-member presidency. The victory would reinforce Dodik's influence despite his conviction last year for defying the international envoy overseeing the 1995 peace agreement, which barred him from the ballot.
* Leftist Denis Becirovic led in the race for the Bosniak seat, and Croat nationalist Darijana Filipovic appears poised to take the seat reserved for her coethnics.
* **Nicaragua withdraws from Central American Parliament:** Nicaragua's foreign ministry [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/f60b6637-16a4-4124-a7fa-47063643fe09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Saturday that it would immediately withdraw from the Central American Parliament, denouncing the 1987 treaty establishing the six-country body and calling its exit "a full exercise of its sovereignty."
* The announcement comes a day after the Organization of American States passed a resolution urging Nicaraguan authorities to free political prisoners and restore civil liberties.
* The move continues a pattern of retreat from international institutions by the government of Daniel Ortega and Rosario Murillo, following Nicaragua's 2023 exit from the OAS, which it called a tool of "U.S. interventionism," and its 2025 announcement of withdrawal from the UN Human Rights Council after a UN report urged action on its rights abuses.
* **Russia strikes Kyiv bridge as Germany 's Merz makes unannounced visit: **Russia [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/47055691-f313-4148-9a93-3b170fbcb0cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Northern Bridge over the Dnipro River in Kyiv on Sunday, the same day German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made an unannounced visit to meet Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. It was the second Kyiv bridge hit this weekend, also damaging a road and hot water supply, according to Mayor Vitali Klitschko.
* Addressing his visit, during which he toured the missile-damaged National Academy of Sciences with Zelenskyy, Merz wrote that "if Russia is not stopped, its war machine will sooner or later turn against us."
* On Sunday, Germany announced that it would send $1.1 billion in military aid to Ukraine, in addition to $394 million to repair Ukraine's energy sector. The two countries are also set to finalize a deal to jointly produce long-range drones capable of traveling more than 600 miles.
* **Zelenskyy says Ukraine ready for U.S.-backed trilateral talks, accuses Russia of sharing jet technology with North Korea:** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy [said](https://substack.com/redirect/56f97a84-2984-40cc-9c33-0be857649323?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at a Kyiv news conference with Merz on Sunday that Ukraine is ready to join trilateral technical-level talks with the U.S. and Russia by the end of October, confirming the UAE, which has hosted prior rounds, could again serve as the venue or "another country proposed by the American side." U.S. mediation efforts had been paused since Washington launched its war on Iran.
* Zelenskyy also [accused](https://substack.com/redirect/cedfdb26-e656-445a-849b-d97de6384951?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Russia on Sunday of sharing jet-drone technology with North Korea, answering "yes, of course" when asked about the matter, adding "they are sharing with North Korea all the technologies... because North Korea helped them with missiles." Russia has sharply increased its use of jet drones against Ukraine in recent weeks, and Ukraine has so far had no effective countermeasure beyond using combat aircraft.
* **Japan summons U.S. ambassador after Marine arrested in Okinawa murder:** Japan [summoned](https://substack.com/redirect/6ac16884-b570-44e0-af84-e32289e34fca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. Ambassador George Glass after Lance Cpl. Devin Jacob Ballard, a 20-year-old U.S. Marine, was arrested on suspicion of robbing and murdering 39-year-old Anna Yagi in Naha, Okinawa.
* Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi called the incident "extremely brutal and heinous" and said Japan "lodged a strong protest" with the U.S. envoy.
* **Philippines accuses Chinese maritime forces of obstructing anti-blast-fishing operation near Thitu Island:** The Philippine Coast Guard [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e99a461d-0527-4612-944c-cd88e2ec35a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sunday that Chinese vessels blocked a Philippine law enforcement operation against a foreign fishing vessel suspected of dynamite fishing near Thitu Island (Pag-asa) in the South China Sea, with two China Coast Guard ships sounding horns, radio-challenging, shadowing, and blocking Philippine boats while a Chinese navy helicopter circled the team four times. The suspect vessel then fled toward Chinese-built Subi Reef, and Philippine authorities ended the pursuit for safety reasons.
* Separately, the Philippine military said a Chinese J-16 fighter jet repeatedly approached and maneuvered close to a Philippine patrol aircraft over Scarborough Shoal on Saturday, creating an aviation safety risk. It condemned China for its "recurring pattern of unsafe and coercive behavior."
